title: Distributions
description: Add up enough small independent chances and their total always spreads into the same bell-shaped curve, whatever the chances were. Unlocks the Normal Distribution Crystal.

puzzle.goal: Add up many small independent random pushes and the total spreads into a bell-shaped curve with centre μ and width σ. Write the height f of that curve at the value x.
puzzle.name: Gaussian density
puzzle.ask: Find f at one width from the centre: x = @{x}, μ = 0, σ = @{σ}.
puzzle.method: The central limit theorem: sums of many independent pieces tend to this curve; the factor in front makes its total area 1.
